title: StairDoors (Forge 1.20.1)
description: Basically ported Andrew6rant's StairDoors Extended to forge 1.20.1 cuz I wanted one
body:
- Place Doors on stairs (and trapdoors)
- it's basically [StairDoors Extended](https://modrinth.com/mod/stairdoors-extended) but I removed support for Autoslabs (which wasn't on forge anyway) and added placement on the hinge side of trapdoors
- I didn't find a similiar mod on Forge and didn't want to install sinytra connection just for this one functon
- I was actually suprised there isn't a forge version for this, I hope I wasn't re-inventing wheels
